name: Exp_BBands_Stop
summary: This EA trades Bollinger Band stop signals, entering long when the upper band stop value is active and the lower band confirms direction, and vice versa for shorts. It uses the custom BBands_Stop_v1 indicator on a configurable timeframe with fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit levels. Position sizing is controlled via a deposit share or fixed lot parameter.
summary_zh: 该EA基于布林带止损指标信号交易，当上轨止损值激活且下轨确认方向时做多，反之做空。使用自定义BBands_Stop_v1指标，在可配置时间周期上运行，采用固定止损止盈水平，仓位通过存款比例或固定手数控制。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于布林带止损指标（BBands_Stop_v1），该指标在价格突破布林带上下轨时产生信号，属于均值回归类策略。入场条件为：当上轨止损值在SignalBar上有值且下轨值在当前bar也存在时开多单；当下轨止损值有值且上轨值存在时开空单。出场条件分为两种：一是通过固定点数的StopLoss和TakeProfit出场，二是通过反向信号平仓（多单在出现空头信号时平仓，空单在出现多头信号时平仓）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值为固定手数，正值为存款比例。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数实现，带有偏移因子MoneyRisk调整布林带偏移距离以控制入场敏感度。策略仅在新K线形成时或SignalBar为0时计算信号，避免重复交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the BBands_Stop_v1 custom indicator, which generates signals when price breaks above or below Bollinger Bands, classifying it as a mean reversion strategy. Entry conditions: a buy signal fires when the upper band stop value is non-zero on the SignalBar and the lower band value also exists on the current bar; conversely, a sell signal fires when the lower band stop value is non-zero and the upper band value is present. Exit conditions are dual: fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit in points provide primary exits, while opposing signals trigger early position closure (longs close on sell signals, shorts close on buy signals). Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit. Money management delegates to TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen), and the MoneyRisk offset factor adjusts the Bollinger Band displacement to control entry sensitivity. The strategy recalculates signals only on new bar formation or when SignalBar equals zero, preventing redundant trades within the same bar.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 交易存款比例，负值为固定手数
parameters.description_en: Trade deposit percentage; negative value = fixed lot size

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点容忍度）
parameters.description_en: Max price deviation in points (slippage tolerance)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 双信号确认机制（上下轨值同时存在才入场），减少假信号
同时支持信号平仓和固定止损止盈，具备双重出场保护
新K线检测机制避免同一bar内重复交易，逻辑清晰
可灵活控制多空方向的开启与平仓权限
使用CopyBuffer失败时设置Recount标志重试，具备基本容错
pros_en: Dual signal confirmation (both upper and lower band values must be present) reduces false signals
Dual exit protection combining signal-based and fixed SL/TP closures
New bar detection prevents redundant trades within the same bar, keeping logic clean
Flexible permission switches for long/short opening and closing independently
Basic fault tolerance with Recount flag on CopyBuffer failure for retry on next tick
cons: 依赖外部自定义指标BBands_Stop_v1，缺乏指标源码透明度
未检查指标缓冲区返回值是否为EMPTY_VALUE，可能将空值误判为有效信号
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下止损止盈可能被轻易触发
仓位管理逻辑委托给外部头文件TradeAlgorithms.mqh，核心资金管理逻辑不可见
SignalBar=1为默认值可能导致信号滞后，且缺少对SignalBar边界值的校验
cons_en: Depends on external custom indicator BBands_Stop_v1 without source code transparency
No EMPTY_VALUE check on indicator buffer values, potentially misinterpreting empty data as valid signals
No spread filter, making Stop Loss and Take Profit vulnerable to high-spread environments
Core money management logic delegated to external TradeAlgorithms.mqh include file, making it opaque
Default SignalBar=1 may cause signal lag, and there is no boundary validation for SignalBar input
improvements: 添加指标缓冲区EMPTY_VALUE检查，避免将无效数据误判为交易信号
增加点差过滤和最小止损距离检查，提高在高点差或低流动性环境下的稳定性
improvements_en: Add EMPTY_VALUE checks on indicator buffer results to avoid misinterpreting invalid data as trading signals
Add spread filtering and minimum stop distance validation to improve stability in high-spread or low-liquidity conditions

risk_points: 指标缓冲区未检查EMPTY_VALUE，可能产生虚假信号导致意外开仓
缺少点差过滤，高点差环境下固定止损可能过近
外部依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh，其内部止损/仓位逻辑不可审计
risk_points_en: Indicator buffer values not checked against EMPTY_VALUE, potentially generating false signals and unexpected positions
No spread filter means fixed Stop Loss may be too close in high-spread conditions
External dependency on TradeAlgorithms.mqh makes internal stop/position logic unauditable
